Observability.//: Ships logs to the local-compose Loki (observability/docker-compose.yml) so they are searchable in Grafana Explore. Fail-open: if Loki isn't running, the sidecar logs to console only.
Observability.//traces: Ships spans to the local-compose Tempo (OTLP/HTTP on 4318), viewed in Grafana Explore -> Tempo. Fail-open like Loki. Console spans stay OFF even here; set Observability__TraceConsoleExporter=true to print them while debugging without Tempo.

EvalResults.//: dotnet run's content root is src/AgentForge.Api, so point at the repo's evals/. results.json exists once `dotnet run --project tests/AgentForge.Evals -- evals` has run; until then the series is absent and the loader says so.
